//: Type-check config for CROSS-PACKAGE full-link tests: server tests that import the real client network layer.
//why: server/auctionsvc/test/auction-fulllink.e2e.test.ts drives client/src/net/WorldApiClient against a real auctionsvc HTTP server, so it needs BOTH sides in one program: DOM lib + client/node_modules (WorldApiClient -> platform/IPlatform -> pixi.js-legacy types) AND server/node_modules + node types (mongodb, node:http/net, full @nw/shared). No pre-existing program is that superset, which is why the file used to sit in auctionsvc/tsconfig.test.json's `exclude` as the repo's one unchecked test file. It lives on the CLIENT side because the client CI job already installs both server/ and client/ deps (ci.yml: 'server install (client's @nw/engine + @nw/shared aliases resolve to server/ TS source)' + 'client install'), whereas server-checks installs server/ only. Run via `npm run typecheck:fulllink` (chained into `npm run typecheck`, so CI's existing client typecheck step covers it).
//paths: Same mappings as tsconfig.json EXCEPT @nw/shared, repointed from src/slg/index.ts to the full src/index.ts: the test imports signToken/SlgError/EquipmentInstance, which the client-facing slg-only barrel deliberately does not re-export. The full barrel is a superset of the slg one, so nothing here resolves differently for client sources -- and the narrow client boundary is still enforced by tsconfig.test.json, the program that actually gates client code.
//types: @types/node is NOT a client devDependency on purpose (adding it would let browser code reference `process`/`Buffer` and still type-check). Rather than install it here, point typeRoots at server/node_modules/@types for this program only.
//include: One entry, not a glob: everything else in the program arrives by import-following. Add a line per future cross-package test.
